defaults.notes: Community upload. The uploader is not verified as the rights holder; availability may change.
defaults.verification: Public metadata read by the October 2026 Sesame Street sweep (links-archive); title, link, uploader and listed duration checked; playback not tested.
defaults.tagEvidence: Characters named in the Muppet Wiki summary of the episode, or in the upload's title; editorial and not exhaustive.
defaults.completenessNote: Metadata checked only. No playback, end-to-end review or reference comparison.

availabilityCheck.method: listing read by the sweep (metadata only)
availabilityCheck.result: Listed; no failure recorded. Not a playback check.

completenessNotes.ss-11: Filename explicitly labels this upload SEGMENTS or scenes from the numbered episode. Metadata checked only; no playback or reference comparison.
completenessNotes.ss-12: Explicit street-scene/story excerpt, sometimes with bonus inserts; not the whole episode. Metadata checked only; no playback or reference comparison.
completenessNotes.ss-19: Mixed Noggin broadcast block containing Sesame Street and other series. Only SS-prefixed labels identify Sesame Street episodes; EC, 321 and SQ1 numbers are excluded. No playback or end-to-end completeness review was performed.
completenessNotes.ss-22: Item metadata explicitly presents a named song, sketch, word segment, selected visit or few seconds from the numbered episode. Metadata checked only; no playback or reference comparison.
completenessNotes.ss-23: Uploader metadata presents this as an episode. Metadata checked only; no playback or reference comparison.
completenessNotes.ss-26: Uploader filename presents the Hurricane installment as an episode. No playback or reference comparison; Part is the story title.
completenessNotes.ss-33: Separately numbered full-episode candidate. Part labels denote a multi-episode story, and Missing in The Missing Melon is a plot word. Metadata checked only; no playback or reference comparison.
completenessNotes.ss-35: One of five short files, 15.11 to 33.44 seconds, held under an item labelled Episode 3138 FULL. These are excerpts; the FULL title does not describe a complete file.
completenessNotes.ss-36: Conflicting item and file labels require content/reference evidence. Do not select the first filename number, assume the item title is correct, or infer a two-episode compilation from duration. Metadata checked only.
completenessNotes.ss-37: The Part label identifies a separately numbered story installment, not a split upload. Metadata checked only; no playback or reference comparison.
